reason: A suggested reboot did not fix the zero traffic counters issue after an SFP replacement, providing a failed troubleshooting attempt.

knowledge.summary: Rebooting the unit did not resolve the issue of zero traffic counters after an SFP replacement on a transmission link.
knowledge.author: Mikko Mäkelä
knowledge.details: Reboot took about 20 minutes, but traffic counters remained at zero on the port.
